summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the first quarter ended June 28, 2026. The filing reports Q1 revenue of C$118.9 million (up from C$107.8 million year-over-year) and a net loss of C$93.0 million (improved from C$125.5 million loss). It includes CEO and CFO certifications and a press release dated July 30, 2026. No special-situations event—acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or capital action—is indicated. The filing is a routine quarterly results report for a foreign private issuer via Form 6-K, with no extraordinary corporate event or transaction disclosed.
